Code review clean. Resolve the merge conflicts before merge. Label: `conflicts`.

I read the full diff and the current upstream `AGENTS.md`. There was no earlier review to check.

The pass order changes before the existing link and pose checks. The app keeps its command, MCP, and undo paths.
The new tests check picked corners, named refusals, unchanged cuts, and ball clearance.

## Local build and tests

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4084`. No GitHub runner ran.
The tested trial merge is `6ac807b19`. Its first parent is the full PR head above.
The tested upstream base is `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`.
That base was already an ancestor of the PR head. The trial merge tree equals the PR tree.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 237 steps; 0 failed; 0 stalled; 25.2 minutes.
- The quick test steps report 2,701 passed, 0 failed, and 107 ignored tests.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps; 0 failed; 0 stalled; 8.7 minutes. The light tests report 11 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- After all mutations were removed, `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test multiaxis raster_seam`: 5 passed; 0 failed.

The quick gate built both changed crates with `--no-run`. Each mapped suite ran by name.
The full quick results are below.

## Extra suites run

The required catalog and golden suites ran by name within the quick gate:

| Suite | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `example_catalog` | 43 | 0 | 4 |
| `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 | 0 | 0 |

| `start_exit_shared` | 33 | 0 | 0 |

No fixture or importer changed. Thus the extra fixture and kernel import rules select no further suites.
No UI file changed. Screenshots are not required for this diff.

## Safety checks and mutations

This is a safety-tier review because the change reorders toolpaths.
I ran each mutation separately in the review worktree. Each run used the five `raster_seam` tests.
Each mutation caused test assertion failures, not a build failure.

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M1: remove the start reach limit | RED: impossible-pick and canopy tests failed; 3 passed, 2 failed |
| M4: omit each pass reversal | RED: start and exit tests failed; 3 passed, 2 failed |
| M5: replace `plunge_support` with `support_at`, removing column trimming | RED: the canopy test failed; 4 passed, 1 failed |
| Restore all source files | GREEN: 5 passed, 0 failed |

No golden or recorded program changed. There are no moved golden lines to check.
The full heavy lanes did not run. The current review law does not require them for this PR.

## Required before merge

Upstream main moved during the local checks. Its latest fetched head is `5b52c5f8ca0a03e8b71af0453056b920b5d9e742`.
A trial merge with that head fails in these files:

- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:400`: the Face description conflicts with the new raster description.
- `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs:97`: main removes Face from the fallback arm where this PR adds Parallel5D.

Refresh the PR with main at merge time. Keep the changes from both sides and run the required checks again.
I did not resolve these code conflicts. The tests above do not cover a merge with the newer main.
I aborted the failed merge and kept the tested review tree. The worktree has no source changes.

There are no blocking code findings. The label is orange because the current PR does not merge cleanly.
The review branch and its build cache remain in place.
